majority_class.definition: Fit on training labels only, then always predict the training majority class.
majority_class.evaluation_rule: For every future validation segment, refit using only its preceding training segment.

persistence.reason: The legacy balancing dataset does not document historical outcome publication delay, so y[t-1] cannot be proven available at the last-pre-delivery cutoff.

availability_safe_supplemental.name: hour_of_week_training_majority
availability_safe_supplemental.definition: Within each training segment, select the most common label for each Danish local weekday-hour; fall back to the global training majority.
availability_safe_supplemental.evaluation_status: registered_before_evaluation; performance belongs to later time-split testing
availability_safe_supplemental.note: This is an availability-safe reference, not a replacement presented as outcome persistence.

interpretation: All P3 accuracy values are development-wide descriptive diagnostics, not out-of-sample model evidence.
